overall.headline: Global EFB and Flight Planning Selections Show Diverse Vendor Adoption Across Carrier Types
observations: Across **519** total airlines, **127** record EFB selections and **68** record flight planning selections in Airtable.
Flag carriers frequently cite **AvioBook** and **In-house built** solutions, while low-cost carriers often lean toward **Navblue Mission+** for EFB operations.
For flight planning, **Lido** leads with **24** of **68** recorded selections, followed by **NavBlue** at **16** selections.
overall.caveat: Counts reflect recorded Airtable selections rather than total market share, and missing data indicates unknown status rather than non-adoption.

regions.name: Europe & Central Asia
regions.headline: Regional Adoption Features Strong In-House and AvioBook Presence Alongside Lido Planning
observations: Among **151** airlines, **35** record EFB selections and **14** record planning selections.
**In-house built** leads EFB selections at **7** of **35** (**20.0%**), contrasting with the global rate.
**Lido** captures **5** of **14** planning selections (**35.7%**), closely aligning with global planning preferences.
regions.caveat: Figures represent recorded selections only; unrecorded carriers do not imply absence of technology.

regions.name: East Asia & Pacific
regions.headline: High Engagement With Paper and In-House Systems Alongside NavBlue Planning
observations: Out of **130** airlines, **39** record EFB selections and **18** record planning selections.
**In-house built** EFB selections reach **9** of **39** (**23.1%**), while **Paper** accounts for **6** of **39** (**15.4%**).
**NavBlue** leads planning selections with **9** of **18** (**50.0%**), exceeding the global planning rate.
regions.caveat: Multi-select fields may count individual airlines multiple times; missing fields are unknown.

regions.name: North America
regions.headline: Concentrated FlightKeys Adoption Outpaces Global Planning Averages
observations: From **59** airlines, **14** record EFB selections and **9** record planning selections.
**AvioBook** leads EFB choices with **5** of **14** selections (**35.7%**), surpassing the global rate.
**FlightKeys** dominates planning with **5** of **9** selections (**55.6%**), far above the global **12** of **68** baseline.
regions.caveat: Low recording denominators for specific sub-segments restrict broad regional generalizations.

regions.name: Latin America & Caribbean
regions.headline: Balanced Vendor Spread With Moderate Lido Flight Planning Representation
observations: Among **56** airlines, **12** record EFB selections and **9** record planning selections.
EFB selections show an even split with **AvioBook**, **Flightman**, and **Paper** each recording **2** of **12** selections (**16.7%** each).
**Lido** leads planning with **4** of **9** selections (**44.4%**), tracking slightly above the global planning rate.
regions.caveat: Recorded counts are strictly observational metrics and do not measure total market penetration.

regions.name: Middle East & North Africa
regions.headline: Equally Distributed EFB Choices Coexist with Lido and NavBlue Planning
observations: Of **51** airlines, **15** record EFB selections and **10** record planning selections.
**Bytron Skybook**, **Jeppesen Aviator**, and **Paper** each record **3** of **15** EFB selections (**20.0%** each).
**Lido** and **NavBlue** tie for planning leadership, each recording **3** of **10** selections (**30.0%** each).
regions.caveat: Unknown fields prevent assumptions regarding unlisted carriers.

regions.name: Sub-Saharan Africa
regions.headline: Limited Dataset Highlights IFS EFBOne and Lido Planning Preferences
observations: Out of **47** airlines, **8** record EFB selections and **4** record planning selections.
**IFS EFBOne** leads EFB selections with **2** of **8** records (**25.0%**), exceeding global adoption rates.
**Lido** captures **2** of **4** planning selections (**50.0%**), outperforming its relative global share in this small sample.
regions.caveat: Small sample sizes require cautious interpretation of percentage differences.

regions.name: South Asia
regions.headline: Fragmented Selections with Equal Split Between Lido and Other Planning Tools
observations: From **13** airlines, **4** record EFB selections and **4** record planning selections.
EFB selections are divided across **AvioBook**, **In-house built**, **Navblue Mission+**, and **Paper** at **1** of **4** each (**25.0%**).
**Lido** secures **2** of **4** planning selections (**50.0%**), while **CAE** and **NavBlue** each hold **1**.
regions.caveat: High rates of unrecorded fields mean these figures apply strictly to reporting entities.

regions.name: Unmapped
regions.headline: Zero Recorded Technology Selections Across Unmapped Carrier Pool
observations: Among **12** unmapped airlines, **0** record EFB selections and **0** record planning selections.
No vendor counts or carrier segment breakdowns are available for analysis.
This segment offers no current data points for evaluating regional system adoption patterns.
regions.caveat: Absence of data reflects unmapped records rather than confirmed lack of technology.
